ja371:1.1: Evaṃbhūtassa te rāja āgatassa vaso mama atthi nu koci pariyāyo yo taṃ dukkhā pamocaye ti.
ja371:2.1: Evaṃbhūtassa me tāta āgatassa vaso tava n' atthi no koci pariyāyo yo maṃ dukkhā pamocaye ti.
ja371:3.1: Nāññaṃ sucaritaṃ rāja nāññaṃ rāja subhāsitaṃ tāyate maraṇakāle, evam ev' itaraṃ dhanaṃ.
ja371:4.1: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ ajini maṃ ahāsi me, (Dhp. v. 3-5.) ye taṃ upanayhanti veraṃ tesaṃ na sammati.
ja371:5.1: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ ajini maṃ ahāsi me, ye taṃ na upanayhanti veraṃ tes' ūpasamati.
ja371:6.1: Na hi verena verāni sammantīdha kudācanaṃ averena ca sammanti, esa dhammo sanantano ti.
